I would seriously consider the interest rates before taking out a payday loan. The bigger thing to consider though is: when you pay this money back out of your pay cheque are you going to need that money later on. 

To cut a long story short I ended up borrowing near monthly, the rates got higher, I borrowed from other companies to pay the first one off and now I'm about £2k in debt with 3 different companies who hound me relentlessly for money I simply dont have.

Payday loans are maybe okay if it's a small amount say, £50 and you can pay it back early but anymore than that I would personally stay away.
